remarks: Imagine a little bit of New York City in New Canaan! Incredible opportunity for a townhouse rental in an extraordinary enclave of luxury lofts and townhouses and experience refined design and the finest hand-crafted finishes. This 3 bedroom, 3 bath townhouse has gorgeous wide plank white oak floors, living room with custom build-ins galore, fireplace with marble surround, 2 car attached garage, designer chef's kitchen with custom milled white oak cabinetry, waterfall leathered granite island, deluxe appliances, ensuite baths with artisan cut marble counters, and primary bath with heated floors. Access to an incredible 1,000 sq/ft roof deck with outdoor kitchen, and grill. The space is perfect for entertaining, dining, and socializing! Enjoy a view of New Canaan like no other! Just off of New Canaan's Restaurant Row and all this that an idyllic historic village has to offer. Small town charm with a NYC vibe. Far enough yet close enough to NYC. *Virtual photos by Bespoke Marketing.
